# Critic pass — brief and state list

You did not build this app. Drive it, don't read it. Compare each built state to the design at 390×844 and report Fidelity (what differs — judge *closer to the reference*, never "better") and Function (broken, dead, unreachable, numbers that disagree between screens, copy drift, PRD contradictions). Every finding: state · what it shows · what it should show · requirement violated. Write findings to `docs/build/CRITIC.md`.

Known, accepted differences (do not report): dates are the real today, not "Aug 12"; the seeded Today reads 84 / 86 g / 1,060 kcal (derived from data, see `docs/build/BUILT_NOT_SHOWN.md`); the design's left rail is not part of the app; failure states are reached via Settings → Demo toggles.

## How to reach every rail state in the app (design rail label → recipe)
**Today** — Scored: launch (seeded). Partial signals: Settings → Reset to fresh → complete onboarding → Today shows Insufficient → Log tab, log Sleep and Energy only → Today shows a reweighted score, ordinary layout, no "missing" notice. Insufficient data: as above before logging. Rest day: Calendar → tap today's Upper body → Reschedule → tomorrow → Today shows "Rest — here's why". LLM error → fallback: Settings → Nora replies: Error → Today (fallback line + "Couldn't reach Nora — retry explanation"). Replay stream: leave and return to Today.
**Calendar** — Planned week: Calendar tab. Single day: tap a strip cell / Day segment. Empty week: › twice to a week with nothing → "Nothing planned yet" + Generate my week. Regenerating: press Generate my week (locked card ~1.5 s, then the week fills). Month: Month segment (nav, Back to today, legend, detail line). Empty day (Rest day card): Day view on a day with nothing. Sheets: activity (tap a row: now/pending/completed/skipped variants; past-due unlogged variant: Reschedule a pending activity to a past day of the visible week, then reopen it), add (+ Add activity; past day vs future label), reschedule, Ask Nora to change.
**Log** — grid; each numeric sheet; supplements sheet; Saved toast.
**Meal photo** — Log → Meal: camera (auto-captures ~3 s) → analyzing → estimate (edit portion, remove, + Add item, Discard/Save). Vision failed: Settings → Vision: Fail → Meal → Retry photo / Enter manually.
**Nora** — Patch thread: seeded (Not now / Apply to calendar / Reconsider / View calendar). Safety reply: send "I felt a sharp pain in my chest during today's sprints and got dizzy." → red safety card → Keep it / Pause it; then Calendar shows the paused session with "I've been seen — resume this". LLM error · retry: Settings → Nora replies: Error → send anything. Offline: Nora replies: Offline. Empty history · intro: after Reset to fresh. Sees N shared signals → What Nora knows.
**Progress** — With PRs (seeded), + PR entry sheet; Empty PRs (fresh). Workout history → Session detail (planned/actual table, note).
**What Nora knows** — With memory (seeded: Resolve/Delete); Empty memory (fresh, no injury/standing activity entered). Reached from Settings and from the Nora header; back returns to whichever opened it.
**Settings** — targets steppers, disclaimer, Demo card.
**Nutrition** — from Today's nutrition card: macros, micros, supplements, This week (same numbers as the calendar week card), What's missing (shimmer → list; Retry on failure via Nora replies: Error), Logged meals.
**Gym player** — Today ▶ or Calendar → today's Upper body → Start session: video, tap left/right, swipe up / tap hint → set panel (check a set → Rest 1:30 + Skip; Form video → Form video screen), Next … Cooldown (last exercise is the cooldown phase), End session → "How did it go?" → Finish; × → "Leaving mid-session" (Save / Discard / Keep training).
**Sprint player** — Calendar → › next week → Sprints → Reschedule → ‹ (back a week) → pick today → Move → the row is now `now` → Start session: warm-up (dark) → Skip stage → sprint (orange) → recovery (green); Pause/Resume; final stage → end sheet.
**Onboarding** — Settings → Reset to fresh: steps 1–5 (Back/Next, chips, day squares, minutes slider, equipment cards, activities chips + Recurring list + Add a standing activity, injuries text) → Build my plan (spinner + copy) → Your first week preview → Looks good / Ask for changes. Generation failed → retry: Settings → Plan generation: Fail before Build my plan (set it in the seeded app, then reset to fresh — the flag survives the reset).
